With the Powerslide Next 2 125 Deep Blue Skates, you can chase the thrill of freedom, carve your own path, and turn the city into your playground. items.description: Powerslide Next 2 80 Chocolate Skates. Powerful, sophisticated, and made for move—introducing the Powerslide Next 80 Chocolate, a cool fusion of elegant design and top-level performance. If you’re commuting long distances or hitting up intense street sessions, the Prime liner provides cushion and performance. A secure fit comes from a triple-closure system – the sturdy Kizer Supreme buckle at the top, the Crown ratchet buckle at the ankle, and grippy waxed laces work together to keep your foot locked in place. No slipping, no distractions – just pure, controlled movement with every stride. Two frame sizes adapt to different foot sizes: a shorter 243mm 4x80mm version for sizes 36/37 to 40/41, and a more stable 275mm 4x90mm version for sizes 42/43 and up. Whichever your setup, the ride feels smooth, responsive, and perfect for urban agility. Paired with Wicked ABEC 9 chrome steel bearings, the spin is fast, fluid, and built to last. The TRINITY 3-point mounting system holds everything together, lowering the center of gravity for improved balance, smoother push-offs, and better energy transfer. It’s your edge when weaving through crowds, hitting sharp corners, or soaking up cracks in the pavement. With a mix of brown hues and sleek silhouette, the Powerslide Next 2 80 Chocolate Skates are the perfect choice for skaters seeking style, power, and precision. Whether you’re carving through alleyways or cruising down boulevards, these skates deliver buttery-smooth performance in a look that stands out from the pack. Go Chocolate. Own your ride.

items.description: Endless Blading Centered Frame Locks. Endless Frame Locks are the missing link for unlocking maximum performance from your 165 mount frames.
